        columns.append(column)
    
    # Create horizontal deck beams
    beams = []
    for i in range(len(columns) - 1):
        col1 = columns[i]
        col2 = columns[i + 1]
        x1 = col1.position.x
        x2 = col2.position.x
        beam_x = (x1 + x2) / 2
        beam_width = x2 - x1

        beam = sandbox.add_beam(x=beam_x, y=11.0, width=beam_width, height=beam_height, density=8.0, friction=0.5)
        # Connect beam to both columns with rigid joints
        sandbox.add_joint(beam, col1, (x1, 11.0), type='rigid')
        sandbox.add_joint(beam, col2, (x2, 11.0), type='rigid')
        beams.append(beam)
    
    # Add cross-braces for lateral stability
    for i in range(len(columns) - 1):
        col1 = columns[i]
        col2 = columns[i + 1]
        x1 = col1.position.x
        x2 = col2.position.x
        cross_x = (x1 + x2) / 2
        cross_width = x2 - x1
        cross_height = 0.5  # Reduced height to stay within mass budget
        cross = sandbox.add_beam(x=cross_x, y=10.5, width=cross_width, height=cross_height, density=8.0, friction=0.5)
        # Connect cross-braces with rigid joints to columns
        sandbox.add_joint(cross, col1, (x1, 10.5), type='rigid')
        sandbox.add_joint(cross, col2, (x2, 10.5), type='rigid')
    
    # Add diagonal trusses to convert torsional loads into axial forces
    for i in range(len(columns) - 1):
        col = columns[i]
        x1 = col.position.x
        # Top of column is at y=11.5 + (3.0/2) = 13.0

        beam_mid_y = beam.position.y  # 11.0
        # Calculate diagonal beam parameters
        dx = beam_mid_x - x1
        dy = beam_mid_y - top_y
        length = math.sqrt(dx**2 + dy**2)
        angle = math.atan2(dy, dx)
        # Midpoint of diagonal beam
        diag_mid_x = (x1 + beam_mid_x) / 2
        diag_mid_y = (top_y + beam_mid_y) / 2
        diagonal = sandbox.add_beam(x=diag_mid_x, y=diag_mid_y, width=0.1, height=length, angle=angle, density=8.0, friction=0.5)
        # Connect diagonal to column and beam with rigid joints
        sandbox.add_joint(diagonal, col, (x1, top_y), type='rigid')
        sandbox.add_joint(diagonal, beam, (beam_mid_x, beam_mid_y), type='rigid')
    
    # Return the first horizontal beam as the chassis reference
    return beams[0]
